name: Aadhaar name update (e.g. after marriage)
name_hi: आधार में नाम अपडेट (जैसे विवाह के बाद)
description: Update the name recorded in Aadhaar at an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre with a supporting Proof of Identity document in the new name.
description_hi: आधार नामांकन केंद्र पर नए नाम वाले पहचान प्रमाण दस्तावेज़ के साथ आधार में दर्ज नाम अपडेट करें।
verification_notes: From UIDAI List IV (update). PoI eligibility marks are images and were checked visually. Only two PoI documents are modelled (marriage certificate, gazette notification); other List IV PoI documents issued in the new name are also accepted but not modelled. UIDAI's online mode is described for address updates only, so the enrolment-centre route is modelled. Limits on how often a name can be changed are not modelled.

requirements.name: Proof of identity in the new name (any one)
requirements.name_hi: नए नाम में पहचान का प्रमाण (कोई एक)
requirements.notes: Documents must be issued in the name of the person seeking the update.

options.notes: Issued by Central/State Government. If it has no photograph, a supporting PoI document bearing the old name with photograph is also required.
For change in first name or full name.
